result.topic_en: A heavily corrected draft, apparently for an autobiographical statement or research programme, in which Riemann lists his planned work: the connection between electricity, light, magnetism and heat (drawing on Newton, Euler and Herbart), introducing imaginaries into the theory of other transcendental functions (with a reference to his dissertation, Art. 20), a method for integrating partial differential equations applied to physical problems, and his partial agreement with Herbart's philosophy.
